groups.name: Electron.js
groups.summary: Native macOS behavior, display capture, protocol validation, developer tools, documentation, and regression testing.

contributions.title: fix: preserve AppKit default menu item titles and icons on macOS
description: **Preserve native macOS menu titles and icons**: Updated native menu state handling to preserve AppKit-managed titles and default icons on macOS Tahoe, including Settings and submenu icons, while still applying explicit changes from JavaScript.

contributions.title: fix: validate protocol scheme names in RegisterSchemesAsPrivileged
description: **Validate custom protocol scheme names**: Added RFC 3986 scheme-name validation to protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged() before custom schemes are registered or forwarded to child processes.

contributions.title: feat: support restrictOwnAudio constraint
description: **Support the restrictOwnAudio constraint**: Fixed display-media audio capture to honor restrictOwnAudio and suppressLocalAudioPlayback by selecting loopbackWithoutChrome on supported platforms, excluding local app playback.

contributions.title: fix: macOS menu roles missing Tahoe icons
description: **Restore macOS Tahoe menu role icons**: Refreshed native menu actions to restore system-provided role icons after menus were reopened. Followed up in #55057 to also preserve submenu icons and AppKit-managed titles.

contributions.title: fix: toggle devtools menu item for BaseWindow
description: **Fix Toggle Developer Tools for BaseWindow**: Fixed a main-process JavaScript error by targeting the focused WebContents when toggling DevTools, allowing the menu role to work with BaseWindow.

contributions.title: test: add desktopCapturer icon validation
description: **Add desktopCapturer icon regression tests**: Added tests that verify captured window icons are present and valid, guarding against regressions like the macOS Tahoe icon retrieval failure in #48063.

contributions.title: chore: backport running mac app icons from chromium (crrev.com/c/7239386)
description: **Backport the macOS Tahoe app icon fix**: Backported Chromium CL 7239386 into Electron to restore running application icon retrieval on macOS Tahoe, resolving #48063.

contributions.title: test: fix flaky BrowserView test
description: **Stabilize BrowserView tests across desktop themes**: Addressed theme-dependent background rendering in BrowserView tests so that Dark mode does not cause false failures.

contributions.title: test: fix flaky BrowserWindow test
description: **Stabilize BrowserWindow tests across desktop themes**: Fixed test failures caused by Chromium applying a dark background to about:blank when the desktop uses Dark mode.

contributions.title: fix: replaces wrong image address in apps page
description: **Fix Electron app icon paths on the apps page**: Updated app icon URLs to include the `apps/` repository prefix, restoring valid 128px app icon addresses on Electron's website.

contributions.title: [emulation] Fix viewport leakage when taking full page screenshots
description: **Fix DevTools viewport leakage during full-page screenshots**: Fixed a screenshot flow that left DevTools with stale viewport dimensions, causing its UI to overlap other components after capturing pages larger than the browser window.
Applied device emulation before capture and restored the viewport in a try/finally block, ensuring cleanup even if screenshot capture fails.

contributions.title: [Mac][editing] Stop selecting word on right-click if caret is already
description: **Preserve the caret when right-clicking on macOS**: Updated Blink’s SelectionController to skip word selection when a right-click matches the existing caret position, preserving native macOS context-menu behavior.
Prevented context-menu paste from unexpectedly replacing a whole word and added a regression test for right-clicking an existing caret.

contributions.title: Mac: Fix WebRTC window icon conversion via gfx::Image
description: **Fix WebRTC window icon conversion on macOS**: Replaced incorrect manual NSImage-to-ImageSkia conversion with gfx::Image to prevent blank or corrupted icons in the WebRTC window picker.
Backported this upstream fix into Electron through PR #50188 to resolve desktopCapturer issue #48063.

contributions.title: Component: fix non-ASCII chars leaking into D-Bus path
description: **Fix Unicode handling in D-Bus object paths**: Fixed character truncation in KGlobalAccelD that allowed non-ASCII characters to pass ASCII validation and produce invalid component paths. Preserved the full Unicode value using char16_t.
Extracted path sanitization into a testable helper and added regression coverage for ASCII, accented Latin, Polish, and CJK component names.

contributions.title: extension: Rename addCallback to addPortCallback
description: **Clarify native-host message callbacks**: Renamed addCallback to addPortCallback and callbacks to portCallbacks throughout the extension, distinguishing native-host port messages from runtime callbacks and resolving existing TODOs.

contributions.title: Fix Microsoft Teams screen share breaking with media controls enabled
description: **Fix Microsoft Teams screen sharing with media controls enabled**: Replaced temporary DOM insertion of detached media players with event-based discovery, preventing the browser extension from disrupting Teams screen sharing.
Passed detached audio and video elements to the content script through an event’s relatedTarget, preserving media-player detection without inserting or removing those elements from the page.
